title: Quadratic form in Euclidean coordinates
statement: For every real number $\rho$ and every vector $t=(t_0,t_1)\in\mathbb{R}^2$, the quadratic form $t_0^2+2\rho t_0t_1+t_1^2$ equals $t^{\mathsf T}\begin{pmatrix}1&\rho\\\rho&1\end{pmatrix}t$.
